message.content:
I need to get IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO) data for Georgia. Specifically:

1. Real GDP level (NGDP_R - Gross domestic product, constant prices, in billions of national currency) from 2000 to 2027
2. Real GDP growth rate (NGDP_RPCH - Gross domestic product, constant prices, percent change) from 2000 to 2027

Try to access the IMF WEO database. The most recent WEO is typically at:
- https://www.imf.org/en/Publications/WEO
- Or the database at: https://www.imf.org/en/Publications/WEO/weo-database/2025/April

Try fetching from:
https://www.imf.org/external/pubs/ft/weo/2025/01/weodata/weorept.aspx?pr.x=0&pr.y=0&sy=2000&ey=2027&scsm=1&ssd=1&sort=country&ds=.&br=1&c=915&s=NGDP_R%2CNGDP_RPCH&grp=0&a=

Country code for Georgia in IMF WEO is 915.

If that doesn't work, try the download link for the full WEO dataset:
https://www.imf.org/-/media/Files/Publications/WEO/WEO-Database/2025/April/WEOApr2025all.ashx

Or try to search the web for the latest available WEO data download URL.

Print ALL the values clearly: year, NGDP_R (real GDP level in billions), NGDP_RPCH (growth rate in %) for each year from 2000 to 2027.

print("-" * 80)

for year in range(target_start, target_end + 1):
    idx = year - years_start
    r_val = ngdp_r_vals[idx] if idx < len(ngdp_r_vals) else "n/a"
    rpch_val = ngdp_rpch_vals[idx] if idx < len(ngdp_rpch_vals) else "n/a"
    
    # Mark estimates
    is_estimate = year > 2023
    marker = " *" if is_estimate else ""
    
    print(f"{year:<8}{r_val:<35}{rpch_val}{marker}")

print("-" * 80)
print()
print("Source: IMF World Economic Outlook Database, October 2024")
print("* = IMF staff estimates/projections")
print("Base year for constant prices: 2019")
print("Chain-weighted: Yes, from 1996")
print("National currency: Georgian Lari (GEL)")

---

### Key metadata:

- **Source**: IMF World Economic Outlook Database, **October 2024** edition (the most recent dataset available for download; the April 2025 edition file was not yet available on the IMF servers)
- **Country code**: 915 (Georgia, ISO: GEO)
- **NGDP_R units**: Billions of Georgian Lari (GEL), constant prices
- **Base year**: 2019
- **Chain-weighted**: Yes, from 1996
- **National accounts manual**: SNA 2008
- **GDP valuation**: Market prices
- **Latest actual data**: 2023 (2024-2029 are estimates/projections)
- **Data last updated by IMF**: September 2024

### Notable observations:

- Georgia experienced **two recessions** in this period: the 2008-2009 financial crisis (GDP shrank -3.65% in 2009) and the COVID-19 pandemic (GDP shrank -6.29% in 2020).
- The **strongest growth years** were 2003 (11.2%), 2007 (12.6%), 2021 (10.6%), and 2022 (11.0%).
- Real GDP roughly **quadrupled** from 16.96 billion GEL in 2000 to a projected 77.26 billion GEL in 2027.
- The IMF projects steady **5.0% growth** for 2026 and 2027.
